newsitem.title: USA: North Coast Energy to fight Lomak.
newsitem.headline: North Coast Energy to fight Lomak.

text.p: North Coast Energy Inc said Monday it intends to pursue legal action to prohibit the voting of a proxy Lomak Petroleum Inc presented at North Coast's annual meeting.

Noting Lomak's recent attempts to elect directors who were not nominated by North Coast, the company said "This entire episode was initiated by Lomak without prior notice. The proxies presented at the meeting were not properly documented."
A Lomak attorney told Reuters September 11 the company had purchased 47 percent of North Coast's stock.
Earlier that day Lomak sued North Coast in Delaware Chancery Court seeking to confirm the election of two Lomak candidates to the North Coast board at the September 11 annual meeting.
The attorney said the suit was filed after the meeting was adjourned before Lomak could vote its proxies.
